neighbours.label: A short literal setting in code or a protocol line: '1' in 'border=1' or 'HTTP/1.1', '=True', '-c'; the same line without that literal stays quiet.
fire: html = "" run(verbose=True) sock.connect(('', 10500)) POST /login HTTP/1.1 bash -c 'pwd' plot(data, grid=True) HEAD /status HTTP/1.1
quiet: html = "" run(verbose) sock.connect((host, port)) POST /login bash script.sh plot(data, grid) HEAD /status

notes: Probes: 0.55-1.02; 'while 1:' read 0.24, and '1' and 'True' in prose 0.01. The '802.11b' example in the top examples is not tested.
